cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What exactly did the manager say about the missing keys? Her words, please, not a reconstruction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Might' isn't a location. Is she asking everyone who locked up, or specifically asking about me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Doing what? Please don't turn 'outside' into 'dropped the keys.' What did the witness actually report?
